PAM only searches email from allow-listed Livin senders, then reads the amount, transaction time, direction and merchant label. Bodies, attachments and message ids are never stored.
Only aggregate monthly and per-category numbers are sent to the analysis provider. No email content, merchant name, private note or message id. Declining AI keeps the recap fully usable.
Sent to your account server: manual transactions and their notes (encrypted at rest). For analysis: inflow and outflow totals, per-category totals, transaction counts and coverage status.
Stays on device: email bodies, subjects, senders, message ids, merchant names, tokens and card numbers.
You can withdraw AI consent at any time; older reports become historical.

Offline demo mode: PAM reads the bundled sample Livin notifications, not a real inbox. Sample rows are replaced by the import result.
Paste your Gmail address and the 16-character App Password. PAM opens INBOX read-only.

Provider: a deterministic on-device analysis engine (no network). You can use analysis without sending data anywhere.

Newest first. Withdrawing adds a new entry instead of deleting the old one.
Local data is kept for at most 24 months. Deleting removes transactions, summaries, analyses, import history and the mailbox connection immediately from this device.
Removed: transactions, summaries, analyses, import history, the mailbox connection and private notes.

This account stores transactions, merchants, notes, monthly aggregates, and analyses on your PAM account server (encrypted at rest).
No server is configured, so this profile stays on your device: an email and a name, no password.
Already have an account? Sign in
No PAM password: Google verifies who you are, then the PAM server creates a new account or opens the existing one.
Manage how you sign in and the inbox connection. Linking Google never changes your transactions, owner or role.
Once linked you can sign in with Google without typing a password. Your PAM account, transactions and Gmail stay exactly the same.

PAM reads Livin emails from the last 12 months in your inbox and syncs them every 15 minutes while the backend runs. Only Livin emails are read.
AI analysis uses a separate consent, so you can link Gmail without enabling AI.
You can link Gmail later from Account or the status panel.
Password must be at least 8 characters.
This email is already registered. Try signing in.
How to create an App Password
1. Open your Google Account → Security. 2. Turn on 2-Step Verification (required). 3. Choose App passwords, create one for PAM, then paste its 16 characters here.

An App Password grants read and send access to your mailbox. PAM only opens INBOX read-only, never sends mail, and stores the password encrypted on this device. It is removed when you disconnect the inbox or sign out.
Email and App Password are both required.
This device still stores %1$d sample rows from demo mode.
Imported rows and manual notes are not removed. The demo month summary is recomputed when you open it.
Delete %1$d demo rows now? This cannot be undone.
Category/note editing and deletion are available after server edit sync (C2B2).
Once saved, this transaction is included in the %1$s summary.

A sanitized business merchant name (max 120 characters), direction, method and category codes are sent to Microsoft Azure (GlobalStandard) for a category suggestion. No amount, date, email body, note, message ID or personal data is sent. GlobalStandard may process outside Japan West; this is not a guarantee of Indonesia-only processing or zero retention. Declining does not block import or summaries.
Needs review: the email only contains a reference number, not a merchant name. Pick a category manually.

Server mode: categories and transaction details are saved to the server. Internal transfer and refund links remain read-only.
The 0.60 review threshold covers parser/import confidence — it is not a model accuracy probability.
